hook.sub: The template did its job. Now it costs you clients. What a custom site changes, in four slides.

pain.headline: What breaks *first*.
items: The site looks like every competitor's
Every change waits on a plugin update
Google cannot tell what you do
The phone number is three taps away
You do not own the thing you paid for

steps.headline: The *mechanism*.
items: A short brief: what the business does and what the site is not doing
A fixed price back within one business day
Design and build by the same person, feedback rounds included
Launch, then hosting and support on one monthly plan

proof.headline: What you *walk away* with.
items: A site built around how your buyers decide
Domain, code and accounts in your name
Found on Google for what you actually do
Someone to call when something breaks

cta.headline: Send the problem, *not the solution*.
cta.body: A short brief is enough. You get a fixed price back, or the honest answer that it should be scoped differently.
